sources.researchNote: The upload description dates the recording to 1926, identifies Henryk Gold and his ensemble in an acoustically recorded instrumental Syrena version and associates the composition with the name Bruno Asper. The project researcher identifies the disc as Syrena 17901; this number is not given in the upload, and its label and matrix have not been independently checked. The 1927 Actuelle Record catalogue separately lists ‘Zgaś lampę’ by Br. Asper, with Gold’s orchestra and a vocal refrain, on Actuelle 7061 r; the Katalog Polskich Płyt Gramofonowych also lists this issue. A relationship between the Actuelle and Syrena recordings has not been established. Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe catalogues an orchestral recording under reference 3/33/0/1/4266 but names neither conductor nor label; its stated 1908–1914 date is inconsistent with the song’s chronology and is not adopted here. The upload’s recording date remains unverified.
